description: AI-161 fixed retrieval evaluation set. Questions are written the way students actually ask them (English and Vietnamese) against the six Python course slide decks in eval/retrieval/corpus. 'expected_documents' lists every corpus file that legitimately contains the answer; a hit means any of them appears in the top-k.
